set.body:
Outcome

Make the first predictive slice an architectural proof rather than a demo.

Acceptance

- Held-out data and target perturbations cannot influence trained preprocessing or learners.
- Dense and operator-backed source paths agree.
- OOF coverage, run-order, row-order, class-order, and seed laws pass.
- Independent dense or R oracle and adversarial class-coverage cases pass.
- JVM and Scala.js work and result receipts reconcile.
set.title: P4A.7: establish predictive leakage, parity, work, and failure courts
